<objective>
Run full presale on iphk.ru (Институт пластической хирургии и косметологии) in PRESALE mode via the test harness built in Plan 07-01. Wait up to 30 minutes for completion. Score the generated report against the 18-item QC checklist (target ≥80% coverage per QC-04). Compare style against the canonical reference `ИПХиК (2).html` using the 5 criteria from D-09. Write `feedback.md` with results, missing sections, identified bugs, and Phase 8 recommendations.

Purpose: iphk.ru is the ONLY niche with a reference HTML for side-by-side comparison (D-01). This test validates the full PRESALE → orchestrator → HTML pipeline against a known-good target. It exercises the Instagram-critical path (plastic_surgery niche triggers IG-02 hard-FAIL logic if Instagram is missing). TST-03 (PRESALE mode) is satisfied here.

Output: Two artifacts in `/opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/`: `proposal.html` (generated by orchestrator) and `feedback.md` (written by Claude). Plus local `07-02-SUMMARY.md` recording the test run.
</objective>

## Phase Goal (MVP)

**As a** Hermes system validator,
**I want to** trigger a PRESALE-mode presale on iphk.ru and score the result against the reference,
**so that** I can confirm the 3-pass orchestrator produces full-coverage HTML reports matching the canonical ИПХиК quality bar.

## User Story (Vertical Slice)

After this plan, the user (upon waking) can open `/opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/proposal.html` side-by-side with `/Users/mikhaileliseev/Downloads/ИПХиК (2).html` and read `feedback.md` for an objective QC score + identified gaps. If the score is ≥80% and no critical bugs are noted, Phase 8 deploy is unblocked for the plastic niche.

    **Step 1 — Clean previous test artifacts (if any):**

    `ssh aim "docker exec aim-hermes sh -c 'rm -f /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/proposal.html /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/metadata.json /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/harness.log 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk'"`

    This ensures we measure THIS run's outputs, not stale files.

    **Step 2 — Launch test harness in background on the server:**

    Use `nohup` + `&` so the orchestrator runs detached from SSH. Output goes to `harness.log`:

    `ssh aim "nohup docker exec -e ORCHESTRATOR_MODE=1 aim-hermes python3 /opt/data/phase7/run_presale_test.py --url https://iphk.ru --slug plastic-iphk --mode PRESALE --niche plastic_surgery --session-id phase7-plastic-iphk > /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/harness.log 2>&1 &"`

    NOTE: The `docker exec -e ORCHESTRATOR_MODE=1` injects the env var ONLY for this process — no container restart needed. Other production traffic is unaffected.

    **Step 3 — Verify process launched (wait 30 seconds, then check):**

    Wait 30s, then: `ssh aim "docker exec aim-hermes ps -ef | grep run_presale_test | grep -v grep"`
    Expected: one line showing the Python process. If empty, the process died — read `harness.log` to diagnose.

    Also tail the log to see initial output: `ssh aim "docker exec aim-hermes tail -20 /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/harness.log"`

    **Step 4 — Poll for completion (up to 30 minutes):**

    The orchestrator takes 15-30 min typically. Poll every 5 minutes using Bash with `timeout=600000` (10 min). Each poll iteration:

    a) Check if process is still running:
       `ssh aim "docker exec aim-hermes ps -ef | grep run_prescale_test.py | grep -v grep | wc -l"`

    b) Check if metadata.json exists (harness writes it on completion/timeout/failure):
       `ssh aim "docker exec aim-hermes test -f /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/metadata.json && echo DONE || echo RUNNING"`

    c) Tail the last 20 log lines to monitor progress:
       `ssh aim "docker exec aim-hermes tail -20 /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/harness.log"`

    If metadata.json exists (DONE), proceed to Step 5. If still running and <30 min elapsed, wait 5 more min and re-poll. If ≥30 min elapsed and still running, treat as TIMEOUT (D-05) — proceed to Step 5 anyway, harness will self-terminate at 30-min wall clock.

    Maximum 6 poll iterations (6 × 5 min = 30 min total).

    **Step 5 — Read metadata.json to determine outcome:**

  <action>
    **Step 1 — Retrieve generated proposal.html from server:**

    `ssh aim "docker exec aim-hermes cat /opt/data/memories/proposals/plastic-iphk/proposal.html" > /tmp/07-02-plastic-proposal.html`

    If file is missing or empty, set `<html_present>` = false and skip scoring — feedback.md will record this as a critical bug.

    **Step 2 — Compute QC checklist coverage (18 items):**

    For each of the 18 QC items, determine: filled / partial / missing / not_applicable. Plastic surgery is an Instagram-critical niche, so item 4 is APPLICABLE (HARD-FAIL if missing per Plan 03-06).

    Use these detection heuristics (regex-based, on the HTML content):
    - Item 0 (About data: ОКВЭД, licenses, revenue): grep for `ОКВЭД|лицензи|выручк` near section 01
    - Item 1 (Market section: competitor table ≥3): count `<tr>` rows in market table, expect ≥4 (header + 3 competitors)
    - Item 2 (Competitors returned): grep for `find_competitors|конкурент` references
    - Item 3 (Experts identified: top-5 ФИО): count expert card blocks, expect ≥3
    - Item 4 (Instagram analysis): grep for `instagram|подписчик|avg.*лайк` — CRITICAL for plastic_surgery niche
    - Item 5 (Content themes with %): grep for `%|тема` near content section
    - Item 6 (Content gaps with severity): grep for `gap|пробел|точка роста`
    - Item 7 (SMI mentions with URLs): count `<a href` links in media section, expect ≥3
    - Item 8 (Forum pains): grep for `форум|страх|пациент.*боят`
    - Item 9 (Revenue current year): grep for `выручк.*\d{4}` or `за 202`
    - Item 10 (Revenue 3-year dynamics with YoY %): grep for `\d{4}.*→.*\d{4}|за 3 года|YoY`
    - Item 11 (Competitor cards detailed): count `.competitor-card` blocks, expect ≥3
    - Item 12 (Whitefields matrix): grep for `whitefield|матрица|сравнени`
    - Item 13 (Strategy 5 directions): grep for `стратеги|направлен` count ≥5 mentions
    - Item 14 (Offer section): grep for `offer|что.*aim.*может|cta`
    - Item 15 (Clinic metrics): grep for `сотрудник|операционн|прибыль`
    - Item 16 (Ratings 2 platforms): grep for `продокторов|яндекс.*карт|2гис|google|zoon|отзовик` count ≥2
    - Item 17 (Expert регалии): grep for `КМН|ДМН|профессор|доцент|кандидат`

    Score each item:
    - `filled` (1.0): clear presence with real data
    - `partial` (0.5): mentioned but shallow (e.g., 1-2 competitors when ≥3 expected)
    - `missing` (0.0): absent
    - `not_applicable` (excluded from denominator — only item 4 for non-critical niches; plastic_surgery keeps it applicable)

    Compute: `coverage_pct = sum(scored_values) / 18 * 100` (rounded to 1 decimal).

    HARD-FAIL override (per Plan 03-06 _apply_niche_conditional_coverage):
    - If niche == plastic_surgery AND item 4 == missing: `coverage_pct = 0`, status = FAIL regardless of other items.

    Pass threshold: ≥80% per QC-04 / D-08.

    **Step 3 — Style comparison with reference (D-09, 5 criteria):**

    For each criterion, compute a numeric score 1-5 by comparing the generated HTML to the reference (both loaded in Claude's context from Step 1 + read_first):

    | Criterion | 1 (poor) | 3 (acceptable) | 5 (matches reference) | Score |
    |-----------|----------|----------------|----------------------|-------|
    | 1. Narrative vs metric dump | Mostly tables/numbers, little prose | Mix of prose and data | Dominated by narrative paragraphs with embedded data (like ref) | ? |
    | 2. Business language | Raw metric labels ("LCP 7.3s") | Some translated ("скорость загрузки 7.3с") | Full business framing ("каждая секунда теряет пациентов") | ? |
    | 3. Gap-blocks present | 0-1 gap blocks | 2-4 gap blocks | ≥5 gap blocks (strength + growth) per reference density | ? |
    | 4. Blockquote per section | 0 blockquotes | Some sections have blockquotes | Every major section has a `<blockquote class="section-insight">` | ? |
    | 5. Cross-references | No cross-links | 1-2 cross-references | Multiple cross-references (fears → strategy, gaps → offer) per reference style | ? |

    Automated proxies (for objective grounding):
    - `grep -c '<div class="gap"' proposal.html` → gap-blocks count
    - `grep -c '<blockquote class="section-insight">' proposal.html` → blockquote count
    - `grep -c 'href="#' proposal.html` → internal anchor cross-references count
    - Word count (wc -w) outside HTML tags → narrative density proxy
    - Run same greps on reference HTML for comparison

    Total style score: sum of 5 criteria, max 25. Compare to reference baseline (reference should score ~22-25 against itself).

    **Step 4 — Identify bugs and missing sections:**

    Cross-reference the QC items marked `missing` or `partial` against:
    - The orchestrator's gap_report from metadata.json (what Pass 2 identified as missing)
    - The html_report_path flow (did generate_html_report actually run? Check Pass 3 status)
    - The harness.log for any exceptions or warnings

    For each missing/partial item, hypothesize WHY:
    - Tool failure (e.g., Perplexity rate limit returned empty Instagram data)
    - LLM skipped a Pass 3 instruction (didn't call generate_html_report with all kwargs)
    - Niche detection mis-classified (e.g., niche=unknown instead of plastic_surgery, causing Instagram not to be required)
    - HTML rendering bug (section built but not wired into _build_report_html)

    Record bugs in feedback.md as: `<bug-id>: <description> | Evidence: <grep/line ref> | Likely cause: <hypothesis> | Phase 8 recommendation: <fix>`.

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Test harness → Production container | Harness runs as a new process inside the existing aim-hermes container with `ORCHESTRATOR_MODE=1` injected. Session ID `phase7-plastic-iphk` is unique — does NOT collide with production sessions. |
| Orchestrator → External APIs | Perplexity, Apify, Firecrawl, DeepSeek APIs called with real keys. Costs accrue per presale run (~$1-5 in API calls). Rate limits apply via existing key-bank rotation. |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-07-02-S | Spoofing | ssh aim (existing key) | accept | Existing SSH access; no new attack surface |
| T-07-02-T | Tampering | Proposal HTML generated by orchestrator | accept | HTML is a test artifact; not consumed by production; verification is post-hoc via feedback.md |
| T-07-02-R | Repudiation | Test run + scoring not attributed | mitigate | All outputs (metadata.json, harness.log, feedback.md, SUMMARY.md) timestamped + git-tracked |
| T-07-02-I | Info disclosure | Real clinic data (iphk.ru) collected into proposal | accept | iphk.ru data is public business info; no PII; same data Hermes already collects in production presales |
| T-07-02-D | DoS | Orchestrator runs for up to 30 min, invokes many tools | mitigate | Hard 30-min asyncio.wait_for timeout; one presale per plan; existing key-bank rate limits; no parallel runs |
| T-07-02-E | EoP | Harness runs as container process | accept | Same privileges as production Hermes; no privilege change |
| T-07-02-SC | Supply chain | No new packages | accept | Only stdlib + existing app imports in harness; no pip/npm |
</threat_model>
